mapper.select: select t.id, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.priority, t.start_time, t.due_time, case when t.due_time is null then false when t.finish_time is null then t.due_time < now() else t.finish_time > t.due_time end as is_overdue, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, t.project_id from task t where t.id = #{taskId} and t.del_flag = 0 limit 1

select su.user_id as userId, su.avatar as avatar, su.nick_name as nickName from task_user tu inner join sys_user su on su.user_id = tu.user_id and su.del_flag = 0 where tu.task_id = #{taskId} and tu.task_role = 2 limit 1

select su.user_id as userId, su.avatar as avatar, su.nick_name as nickName from task_user tu inner join sys_user su on su.user_id = tu.user_id and su.del_flag = 0 where tu.task_id = #{taskId} order by case when tu.task_role = 2 then 0 else 1 end, su.user_id asc

select su.user_id as userId, su.avatar as avatar, su.nick_name as nickName from task_user tu inner join sys_user su on su.user_id = tu.user_id and su.del_flag = 0 where tu.task_id = #{taskId} and tu.task_role = 2 limit 1

select tr.id, tr.task_id, tr.operator_id, su.nick_name as operator_name, su.avatar as operator_avatar, tr.action_type, tr.remark, tr.create_time from task_record tr left join sys_user su on su.user_id = tr.operator_id and su.del_flag = 0 where tr.task_id = #{taskId} order by tr.create_time desc, tr.id desc
select ta.id, ta.task_id as taskId, ta.record_id as recordId, ta.file_name as fileName, ta.file_url as fileUrl from task_attachment ta where ta.record_id = #{recordId} order by ta.id asc

select t.id, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.priority, t.start_time, t.due_time, case when t.due_time is null then false when t.finish_time is null then t.due_time < now() else t.finish_time > t.due_time end as is_overdue, t.remark from task t where t.del_flag = 0 and exists ( select 1 from task_user tu where tu.task_id = t.id and tu.user_id = #{userId} ) and t.due_time is not null and t.create_time <= #{monthEnd} and t.due_time >= #{monthStart} order by ifnull(t.create_time, t.due_time) asc, t.id desc

select t.id, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.priority, t.start_time, t.due_time, case when t.due_time is null then false when t.finish_time is null then t.due_time < now() else t.finish_time > t.due_time end as is_overdue, t.remark from task t where t.del_flag = 0 and t.project_id = #{projectId} and t.type = 1 order by t.create_time desc
